propositions: A project-configured LLM-backed code-review criterion merges successfully via overlay but never executes, causing a silent failure indistinguishable from a clean rubric.

Activated project criteria must run exactly once via runner-side dynamic fan-in on the round_a step, deduplicated and never appended for round_b, without a workflow DSL field or hard-coded criterion id.
Logical project.<name> criteria map to physical prompt id code-review-project-<name-with-dots-dashed>, with translation only at asset dispatch and routing keyed by logical ids.
An activated missing or malformed project prompt/eval asset must raise a located LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping or emitting empty findings.
criteria eval must accept a logical code-review project id only when active, mapping to the physical id and rejecting unknown, inactive, or dual-gate ambiguous ids.
Pass 3 must use repository-effective threshold, blocking posture, and nit-suppression routing without invoking an LLM, while overlay-absent repositories retain unchanged behavior.
